body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"siainbuletin"} -->
_Requested by **Sia** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01KaQfLZaF43QUMN3kcT7pW2?thread=cmsg_01KaQfLZaF43QUMN3kcT7pW2KUCM39dWJy6NCg5K1jzhBN)_

**Stacked on #37** (merge #37 first and GitHub retargets this to `main`). #46 is already merged and is in #37's branch. This replaces #57, which I closed because its branch carried the wrong number.

**Before:** four modules for graphs of notes (`sp-dgraphs`, `sp-dyn-graph`, `sp-relationship-annotator`, `sp-relationship-annotator-live`), each with its own doc and its own entry in `lem--late-modules`, with nothing saying which of them are packages and which are my code.

**After:** one module, `libraries/modules/custom/sp-graphs.el` (plus its page template `sp-graphs.html`), and one literate doc, `docs/tangles/custom/sp-graphs.org`.
- The doc has a side-by-side table of the four, a list of how they differ, and two clearly separated parts: *Installed with use-package* (`discourse-graphs` with all its `dg-` settings, and `vulpea-graph`, both Elpaca `:ensure` recipes) and *Custom code* (the relationship annotator and the live view, documented as before).
- Behaviour, command names, options and the `dg-` settings are unchanged. The `.el` is the four old files in the old order; only the headers, the `provide` and the live module's `(require 'sp-relationship-annotator)` are gone. The page template is byte-identical to the old one, only renamed.
- `lem--late-modules` lists `sp-graphs` where the four were (nine late modules instead of twelve). `docs/main.org`, `docs/load-order.org` (text, graph source and the re-rendered `load-order-modules.svg`), `sp-config-profiles.el`, `conditional-loading.org` and the comparison doc follow. CHANGELOG has a new "Graph modules" set (#37's two entries moved into it, ahead of this one) and the repeated `Changed`/`Fixed` headings in "Open pull requests" are merged.
- The annotator's line-by-line notes no longer give `.el` line numbers, since the tangled file is now a different one. The HTML notes keep theirs.

**Checked** (Emacs 29.3, container): the doc tangles to `sp-graphs.el` and `sp-graphs.html`; every old code block appears in the new `.el` (compared with whitespace ignored); retangling gives identical files; byte-compile warnings are the same as for the old files; with `vulpea`, `vui` and `use-package` stubbed, the file loads, both `use-package` forms are seen, all eleven commands are defined and the page template and vendored scripts are found next to the file.
**Not checked:** a real start with Elpaca and your notes, `discourse-graphs` or `vulpea-graph` running, the live server in this combined file (its code is unchanged, and #37's tests were not rerun). I did not read the `vulpea-graph` source, so the doc describes it only from its recipe, commands and dependencies.

**Conflicts to expect:** #12, #36, #39 and #50 edit the module list or docs next to these lines, and #54 edits `docs/load-order.org` and the `init.el` comment; the fixes are one-liners (use `sp-graphs`). #39 (`sp-embr`) mentions `sp-relationship-annotator` in its text only. CHANGELOG.org will also conflict with the other open PRs that add entries.

🤖 Generated with [Claude Code](https://claude.com/claude-code)

https://claude.ai/code/session_01GEDRFiEotkaRtWpM8dVG3Y

commit.message:
Combine the four graph modules into sp-graphs

sp-dgraphs, sp-dyn-graph, sp-relationship-annotator and
sp-relationship-annotator-live become one module and one literate doc.
The doc separates the use-package installs (discourse-graphs,
vulpea-graph) from the custom code and compares the four. lem--late-modules,
docs/main.org, docs/load-order.org and the profile lists follow.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
